statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and dizziness
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the requested service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to optimize rate and rhythm control strategies
